subject: planner: add back children's `Schema` when checking `LogicalJoin`'s used columns in column pruning (#60694)
summary: Diff scope: `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go` (plus integration test). Change makes `LogicalJoin.ExtractUsedCols` treat a join-child’s `FullSchema` as additive instead of replacing the child’s `Schema`, preventing column-pruning from dropping columns that exist in a child join’s current `Schema` but not in its (sometimes partial) `FullSchema` (e.g., joins built in `expression_rewriter.go` can carry only the left side’s `FullSchema`). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in this commit; upstream later further generalized this area (e.g. `59672be01c` on `upstream/master`) without indicating a regression from this change.
